properties.notes: Partial demolition and redevelopment of existing residential block to provide 10 residential units (5 x 1bed, 4 x 2bed & 1 x 3bed units). Physical works include a new mansard roof with dormers and demolition of part of the existing building to provide a larger side/rear extension. The rebuilding of the front corner of the original public house to match existing.
